Çözümün tamamı:

**Dockerfile**

```dockerfile
FROM python:3.13-slim
RUN useradd --create-home --uid 1000 app
WORKDIR /app
COPY counter.py .
RUN mkdir -p /data && chown app:app /data
VOLUME /data
USER app
CMD ["python", "counter.py"]
```
